description_for_human: SuccessFactors workforce intelligence for the Velora Executive Agent
description_for_model: Use these SAP SuccessFactors tools for authorized headcount, Emiratisation, employee, job, and organization facts. Keep Emiratisation aggregate and never invent values when a tool reports an error or missing configuration.

functions.name: sf__get_workforce_drilldown
functions.description: Drill down from aggregate groups (such as 'Who are the 15 employees in Unassigned?') into individual employee records governed by active Dataverse disclosure policy. Enforces field allowlists, server-side age ranges, original hire dates, and role verification.

functions.name: sf__check_and_record_consent
functions.description: Check whether the authenticated user has agreed to the Velora confidentiality notice or record user acceptance in Dataverse.

functions.name: sf__get_session_greeting
functions.description: Present the initial session greeting and capability starters while asynchronously loading 30-day user memory in the background.

functions.name: sf__recall_user_memory
functions.description: Recall past conversation topics, decisions, and follow-up items from the user's 30-day Dataverse memory partition.

functions.name: sf__get_joiners
functions.description: Use for aggregate hires, joiners, and hiring trends over an inclusive YYYY-MM-DD range. Returns distinct employees, reconciled breakdowns, UAE/non-UAE/missing-nationality aggregates when available, coverage, population definition, and rule version. Never use employee-directory records to calculate hiring analytics.

functions.name: sf__get_leavers
functions.description: Use for aggregate separations and leavers over an inclusive YYYY-MM-DD range. Returns only verified counts and reconciled time breakdowns; unavailable reason or organization classifications are explicitly unclassified and never estimated.

functions.name: sf__get_attrition
functions.description: Use for period attrition after verified leaver and active-headcount queries succeed. Returns numerator, denominator, formula, denominator method, UAE National rate when independently verified, rule version, and warnings; never substitutes historical values.

functions.name: sf__get_joiners_leavers_trend
functions.description: Use for reconciled joiner-versus-leaver trends over one inclusive reporting window. Every period is calculated from live joiner and leaver results; period totals must match headline totals and zero denominators are not converted to fallback values.

functions.name: sf__get_headcount
functions.description: Use for aggregate workforce headcount and department distribution. Returns distinct current-effective employees, active headcount, complete pagination, reconciled breakdowns, population definitions, effective date, coverage, source metadata, and rule version.

functions.name: sf__get_analytics_dashboard
functions.description: Use only for a combined workforce overview built from independently verified SuccessFactors KPIs. Preserve each KPI's population, period, coverage, source, and warnings; omit any KPI whose query failed.

functions.name: sf__get_emiratisation_kpi
functions.description: Use for aggregate Emiratisation, UAE National, non-UAE National, expatriate-share, or nationality-mix questions. Uses the configured PerPersonal nationality mapping and the same population scope for numerator and denominator; returns active and total counts, missing nationality, rates, target gap in percentage points, reconciliation, rule version, and warnings. Never exposes individual nationality or uses fallback values.

functions.name: sf__get_emp_jobs
functions.description: Use only for an authorized, narrowly filtered employee or organization job-history lookup. Never use for aggregate headcount. Returns a minimized field allowlist plus total, rows returned, and partial-result status.

functions.name: sf__get_emp_job_detail
functions.description: Use only for an authorized lookup of one identified employee and job-history sequence. Returns only approved job fields and effective dates.

functions.name: sf__get_users
functions.description: Use for a narrow employee-directory lookup by name, email, ID, or department. Requires a lookup filter, returns directory-safe fields only, and must not be used to enumerate the workforce or calculate analytics.

functions.name: sf__get_user_detail
functions.description: Use only for an authorized lookup of one resolved employee ID. Returns an approved directory-safe field allowlist rather than the full User entity.

functions.name: sf__get_employment_info
functions.description: Use only for an authorized employment-date or employment-relationship question about one identified employee. Returns a minimized effective-date field allowlist.

functions.name: sf__get_org_units
functions.description: Use to resolve exact SuccessFactors company, business-unit, division, or department codes before applying organization filters. Returns total, rows returned, and completeness status.
